St Mirren v Rangers (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the Scottish Premiership match from The Marbill Coaches Stadium. This is the third meeting between these two sides already this season, with the visitors coming out on top in the previous two games. Rangers hammered their hosts 5-1 in the second round of the League Cup back in August before they claimed a 1-0 victory at Ibrox in the league three weeks later.

Liverpool v Arsenal (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the Women's Super League match from Anfield. The visitors picked up all three points in this meeting last season, as they came away with an impressive 3-1 victory. Three first-half goals in 16 minutes from Stina Blackstenius, Mariona Caldentey and Alessia Russo put the Gunners 3-0 up at half-time, before Zara Shaw scored a 71st-minute consolation for Liverpool.

Atlanta Falcons v Cincinnati Bengals (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the week nine match from Bernabeu in Madrid, as the NFL comes to Spain for the second year in a row. Last year's game at this stadium saw the Washington Commanders take on the Miami Dolphins in a thrilling game that saw the Dolphins win 16-13 in over-time. Today's meeting between the Falcons and the Bengals is the first time the sides have met since October 2022 when Cincinnati claimed an impressive 35-17 victory at home.

Coverage of the NFL Network show that switches between today's games, featuring all the latest developments and score updates. Anytime a team reaches their opponents 20-yard line the attention will focus to that encounter, with several games being shown on screen at any one time if necessary. Every touchdown, extra point and field goal attempt will be shown, as well as all of the day's outstanding plays, all without interruption for commercials.
